note: Guards are hard: a candidate failing any of them has no score. Positive paired deltas are candidate minus baseline. v4 adds two conduct guards from the user's replay verdict of 19 Sep 2026 (the drills survivor hung back and fought from the open). v3, plan 018 (user decisions 18 Sep 2026): the objective is the attack on a static defence on generated town maps; symmetric town battles carry the paired behaviour guards; generated trench maps only prove soldiers still shoot. The selectors guard is relative to the lineage root (no selector the root passes may fail); parity is the lineage rule (controllers the node does not own stay digest-identical, static-defence battle included). v1 and v2 are preserved beside this file. v7: the seen-at-all backstop allows 5 points when flanking fire is reliably above the baseline (user decision 21 Sep 2026). v8, Jordan's ruling of 24 Sep 2026 ("Towns should no longer be included in our runs"): the objective and every battle and paired guard move from the town and trench sets to the village and city2 families, fought in each family's natural state (--concealment --prone --vaulting, tools/loop/config.py FAMILY_FLAGS); thresholds, rules and tolerances unchanged (guards are not weakened). A paired guard listing two sets must pass on each set. v7 is preserved as guards-v7.json.

objective.note: Per battle: defenders put out of action (fraction of the 12) minus half the attacker's own loss fraction, against Ember soldiers who hold cover and never relocate, on generated village and city2 maps with --concealment --prone --vaulting. Mean per set with a cluster bootstrap on the map. v8: ranked on village-attack-val and city2-attack-val together, each family weighted one half: a root is valued at the mean of the two sets' means; a child at its root's value plus the lower 95 % bound of the equally weighted mean of its two paired deltas against the root, from a bootstrap that resamples maps within each family (stratified). Not the mean of the two lower bounds: that adds the two families' uncertainties linearly instead of in quadrature, so it is up to 1.41 times too wide and hides real gains; the stratified bound keeps the same equal weights and is exact for the mean the value names. The mean of the two lower bounds is still reported beside it. Development sets (village-attack-dev, city2-attack-dev) are reported, not ranked. Cleared share and both loss fractions are reported, not optimised. Attack only: defence and a manoeuvring enemy are not measured (plan 018 limits).
